verdict.rationale: Antigravity's Editor view ships a "context-aware configurable agent" with natural language code commands and a conversation prompt box with a model selector, and it draws on project-level folder context (docs-6, docs-16, docs-17). Community hands-on reports confirm it is a Cursor-like VSCode fork with built-in multi-model chat, and mention an official VSCode extension (comm-1, comm-18). missing for 10: first-party docs detailing the in-editor chat panel's contextual features (e.g., selection/open-file context, inline chat), independent hands-on corroboration of chat quality inside the IDE.
